skills_tools_canon.record: THE PROPOSED RULING, embodied in the built piece (script v3 ⚠ box + scene build): 'the boundary is the mechanism' — a tool is a connection the model calls: it reaches outside the model and ACTS in the world (proposed calls executed only as permitted); a skill is know-how the harness carries — a packaged way of working, held as durable files — that never acts itself; it GUIDES how the model works. Tools act. Skills guide. It lives in the piece at L6 ('A skill is different: know-how the system carries — it guides, it never acts') and in L3's one reworded word ('connection' handed to the model, canon §1's own gloss, replacing i2's bare 'capability'). story_structure.value: Problem–Agitation–Solution (urgency), declared before drafting because this definition is about a gap (saying vs doing) and PAS is the gap-shaped structure. PROBLEM: the model can only make words (L1–L2). AGITATION: perfect words that still do nothing — the email sits unsent. SOLUTION: a tool — the model asks, the tool acts, permission decides (L3–L9). The locked script's HS-09 reads the same arc as an S-11 misconception-correction: the viewer's existing model ('the AI sends my emails') is the thing being reassigned. Intended feeling: the invisible hand revealed — 'every time it just did it, there was a hand I never saw.'
